# name: The owl messengers; the fathers go down to Xibalba
# title: Catecut qui petic zamahel
# fols: fols. 13r–14v
Catecut qui petic zamahel rumal Huncame, Vvcub Came: “Quix bec, ix rahpop achih, he itaca ri Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu. Quix ꜭha ta: Quix opon cuꜭ. Que petoc, que ꜭha ahauab chivech. Varal tah que vl chaaha vi cuꜭ; chi ca caztah ta ca vach cuꜭ. Quiꜩih ca ca maihah qui chi. Quehecut que pe vi, que ꜭha ahauab. Chi qui cam cu vloc ri qui choconizan, qui bate, qui pachcab; chi pe naipuch ri qui quic, que ꜭha ahauab. Quix ꜭha ta: Quix oponoc,” xe vꜭhaxic ri zamahel.

Are cut qui zamahel ri Tucur: Chabi Tucur, Huracan Tucur, Caquix Tucur, Holom Tucur, que vꜭhaxic v zamahel Xibalba. Are ri Chabi Tucur queheri chab, xa copquic; are curi Huracan Tucur, xa hun racan ꜭo vxic. Are curi Caquix Tucur, caꜫ rih ꜭo vxic; are chi naipuch ri Holom Tucur, xa vtuquel vholom, ma habi racan, xa vxic ꜭolic.

E cahib ri zamahel, rahpop achihab. Que calem ta xe pe cut chila chi Xibalba; libah chi xe vlic, e cu tacal chuvi hom. Que chaah cut Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu pa hom ri Nim Xob Carchah chuꜭhaxic.

E cu tacatoh ri Tucur chuvi hom ta xqui zac cut qui ꜩih; xavi xere vcholic vꜩih Huncame, Vvcub Came, Ahalpuh, Ahalcana, Chamiabac, Chamiaholom, Xiquiripat, Cuchumaquic, Ahalmez, Ahaltocob, Xic, Patan, qui bi conohel ahauab. Xꜩac qui ꜩih cumal Tucur.

“Ma quiꜩih ca ꜭha ahau Huncame, Vvcub Came?” “Quiꜩih bala,” que ꜭha. “Oh na cu achbilai ive?” “Chi cam vloc ri ronohel queꜩabal, que ꜭha ahauab.” “Vꜩ bala; coh iuoiobeh na. Oh na ca pixabah can na ca chuch,” xeꜭha cut.

Xe be cut chi cochoch, xeꜭha cut chire qui chuch (xcaminac oc qui cahau): “Ho na, ix ca chuch; xa et culic. Mi xul v zamahel ahau, camol que. Que pe toc, ca ꜭha cut, que ꜭha tacol que. Xchi canah cu cana va ca quic,” xeꜭha cut. Cate xbe qui xima can oc pu vi ha ꜭohul. “Na cate chi ca choconizah chic. Xa quix ꜩuan oc, xa pu quix bixan oc, quix ziban oc, quix coton oc; chi mecoh cochoch, chi mecoh puch iꜭux ivatit,” xe vꜭhax cut Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen ta xe pixabaxic.

Quzquz cut choc qui chuch ri Xmucane. “Ho na; ma habi coh camic, mi xbizonic,” xeꜭha ta xe bec Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu.

Cate puch ta xe bec Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu, xcam qui be cumal ri zamahel. Ta xe cah cut pu beal Xibalba, xuluxuh vchi cumuc.

Xe cah cut ta xe el chi cu apon oc chu chi hal ha zivanub, Nuzivan Cul, Cuzivan v bi. Xe eco vi; xe eco chi cut chupan halhal ha zimah; maui ahilan zimah. Xe icou vi, maui xe tocotahic.

Ta xe opon chicut chi a, chi quiqui a; xe icou chiri, maui xcucah. Xe opon chi a vtuquel puch chi a, maui xe chacatahic. Xavi xe icou chic, ta xe opon chicut pa cahib xalcat be; ca chiri cut xe chacatah vi pa cahib xalcat be: hun ꜫaꜫa be, hun cut queca be, zaqui be hun, hun cut ꜫana be, cahib be.

Are cut xꜭhau ri queca be: “In quinicamo, in vbe ahau,” xꜭhau ri be. Chiri cut xe ꜭhacatah vi. Are xqui taqueh ri be Xibalba, ta xe opon cut pa qui popobal rahaual Xibalba; xe chacatah chicut chiri.

Are nabe cubulel ri xa poy, xa aham che, cautalic cumal Xibalba. Are cut nabe xqui quihila: “Cala, Huncame,” xeꜭha chire ri poy. “Cala, Vvcub Came,” xeꜭha chic chire ri aham che. Ma cu xeꜭhacovic.

Catecut xe humuhub rahaual Xibalba chi ꜩe; xa que humin chic chi ꜩe conohel ahauab, rumal xe chacomahic chi qui ꜭux, xqui chac ri Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu. Xe ꜩeen na.

Catecut xeꜭhau chic Huncame, Vvcub Came: “Vꜩ bala, mix ix vlic. Chuvec chi caza vvach, ibate, ipachcab,” xe vꜭhax cut. “Quix cu vloc chuvi ca tem,” xe vꜭhaxic. Vtuquel cu catanalah abah qui tem. Xyaic, xe cat chicut chuvi tem; quiꜩih vi xe pizcalih chic chuvi tem, maui xe yacamaric; quiꜩih vi xe valehic, xcat qui culibal.

Catecut xe ꜩeen chic Xibalba, xe pichicharic chi ꜩe; xvinaquiriheic vcumaꜩ ꜩe chi qui ꜭux, chi qui quiquib, chi qui baquib chi ꜩe conohel rahaual Xibalba. “Xa hix chi ha; ve chi be yaoc ichah, izic chi varabal,” xe vꜭhax cut.

Catecut xe oponic pa Queꜫuma Ha; vtuquel queꜫum vpam chi ha. Ta xqui cam cut qui naoh Xibalba: “Xa que ca puzu chuvec; xa labe huzu huzu que camic, rumal vi queꜩabal ri ca chahibal,” que ꜭha curi Xibalba chi quibil quib.

Are curi qui chah xa coloquic cha, Zaquitoc v bi ri chah, v chah Xibalba; xa hucul qui chaah, xa huzuc chi yohyox bac chicou vi ri qui chaah Xibalba.

Xe oc cut ri Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu chupan ri Queꜫuma Ha. Ta xbe cu yaoc qui chah, xa hun chi chah ꜩihom chic xel ruꜭ Huncame, Vvcub Came, ruꜭ huhun qui zic, xavi ꜩihon chic xel cuꜭ ahauab. Ta xbe cu yaoc cuꜭ ri Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu, e chocochoh chi vloc pa queꜫum, ta xopon ri yaol qui chah ruꜭ qui zic. Cahulhut ri chah xoc apon oc. Ri qui chah e qui ꜩiha ri huhun qui zic. “He chul qui ya chi zaquiric, maui chi quizic; xavi xere v vach chul qui moloba,” que ꜭha ahauab chive, xe vꜭhaxic. Xe chacatah cut. Xqui quiz ri chah, xqui quiz curi zic, xha yao chique. Ꜩaꜩ curi vtihobal Xibalba, quia molah chi tihobal.
